answer.lead: Remote-approved employees can claim a one-time $500 home-office stipend, plus $50 a month toward home internet.

policy_facts.text: Remote-approved employees can claim a one-time $500 stipend for a desk, chair, lighting or similar home-workspace items. It isn't repeated each year.

policy_facts.text: If you already received the office-hybrid stipend and later become remote-approved, you can claim the difference between the two amounts. Items bought with the stipend are yours to keep.

recommendations.text: Keep your receipts and submit the stipend claim within 90 days of your remote arrangement starting.
If you'd like to check your own eligibility or Work Arrangement, choose who you are in the "Speaking as" picker and ask again.

passages.title: Equipment & Home-Office Stipend
passages.text:
Remote-approved employees can claim a one-time home-office stipend of $500 toward a desk, chair, lighting or similar items for their home workspace.
The stipend is one-time: it is not repeated each year. An employee who already received the office-hybrid stipend and later becomes remote-approved can claim the difference between the two amounts. Items bought with the stipend are yours to keep.

passages.title: Equipment & Home-Office Stipend
passages.text: Remote-approved employees can also claim $50 per month toward home internet. Office-hybrid employees cannot claim internet costs.

passages.title: Equipment & Home-Office Stipend
passages.text:
Office-hybrid employees can claim a one-time home-office stipend of $250 for their remote days.
Suitable items include a desk chair, a monitor arm, a desk lamp or a keyboard. The stipend can't be used for furniture unrelated to work or for general household items.

passages.title: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
passages.text: Remote-approved employees work remotely most of the time. The arrangement must be approved by both the manager and HR. Remote-approved employees spend at least one week per quarter at their home office.

passages.title: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy
passages.text: Ridgeline provides your equipment and, where eligible, a home-office stipend; see the Equipment & Home-Office Stipend policy (RSE-EQ-01).

Claim the stipend through an expense claim within 90 days of becoming eligible, with receipts. Your manager approves the claim (RSE-APR-01 §5).
You become eligible on the day your Work Arrangement starts, or on your hire date if you join with that arrangement. The internet allowance is claimed monthly as an expense, with the bill attached.
